Synthetic long-form plain text fixture for the S10 chunking tests.

Synthetic paragraph 01 explains spaced repetition with short daily reviews instead of long cramming sessions.

Synthetic paragraph 02 describes how a learner schedules reviews across several days to move facts into long term memory.

Synthetic paragraph 03 keeps a steady rhythm of sentences so that the window measurements stay predictable in tests.

Synthetic paragraph 04 mentions that every sentence here is invented fixture data and never real course material.

Synthetic paragraph 05 repeats the same shape with different numbers so paragraph boundaries are easy to tell apart.

Synthetic paragraph 06 stresses the character count with a longer clause that pushes the text well past a single chunk.

Synthetic paragraph 07 stays plain ASCII so the strict UTF-8 decoder and the content sniffer accept the file unchanged.

Synthetic paragraph 08 is here to force the window step to walk several times before it reaches the end of the text.

Synthetic paragraph 09 notes that overlap must be measured between consecutive chunks rather than assumed from code.

Synthetic paragraph 10 keeps enough words around the boundary so a cut in the middle of a sentence is visible.

Synthetic paragraph 11 asserts nothing on its own; the assertions live in the tests that read this fixture.

Synthetic paragraph 12 pads the file so that a configured size of two hundred fifty six characters is crossed many times.

Synthetic paragraph 13 finishes the numbered sequence while still reading like ordinary plain text content.

Synthetic paragraph 14 closes the fixture with a final sentence that marks the end of the long input document.
